title: skills: objectstack-ui teaches that a select option is coloured only when it declares `color` (after #36882)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled, the `Skills-docs:` term (5) of the ruling on #36882 (comment 7178358629; Bill, decision card 2026-11-26T00:01Z, 「A 全部去掉，没配就灰」), filed by the owning zone under the parent. Source: maintainer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug (skills text that will teach the old renderer default) · p2 · reach: every AI client authoring select fields from the published skills · evidence: ruling text.

## What

After #36882, a select option with no declared `color` renders neutral; the renderer no longer picks a colour from the value. The analysis 7178076533 §Execution 2 names the line: "`Skills-docs:` a line in `skills/objectstack-ui` that colour is declared via `color`".
- Add that line where `skills/objectstack-ui` teaches select options / badges; remove or correct any text that implies automatic colouring by value.

## Acceptance

- The skill states that colour on a select option badge appears only when the option declares `color` (family name or hex), and undeclared options render neutral.
- Net added lines small (the PM sets the budget at dispatch); governed surface, contract-tier build and review.

## Order

After the #36882 PR merges.

Blocked-by: #36882

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5) via a contract-tier card thread; the #36882 PR's `Skills-docs:` line points here.
Dedupe: open issues for "objectstack-ui select color" return none.
